Name: Quality to Quantity - Cooking
Author: SkylineBrian
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]In vanilla Stardew Valley, high-quality ingredients lose their quality premium when used for cooking because cooked dishes have no quality. Mods that add quality to cooked food can solve this, but may create extra inventory and storage stacks.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b]Quality to Quantity - Cooking[/b] offers a different solution: higher-quality ingredients give you a chance to produce more servings instead. Better ingredients can yield [b]2x, 3x, or 4x food[/b], while cooked dishes remain normal quality and stack normally. The default probabilities preserve the ingredients' long-run expected value, so quality is rewarded without making cooking inherently more profitable.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Extract [b]Quality to Quantity - Cooking[/b] into your Stardew Valley/Mods [/color][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Optionally install Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) to customize the settings in-game.
[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Converts ingredient quality into chances for [b]1x–4x cooking output[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Default expected yields match vanilla quality value multipliers: [b]Normal 1.00x, Silver 1.25x, Gold 1.50x, Iridium 2.00x[/b].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Tracks the [b]actual ingredients consumed[/b], including mixed-quality ingredients and multiple units.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Keeps cooked dishes at normal quality, avoiding additional quality-based storage stacks.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Supports vanilla recipes and compatible [b]SpaceCore[/b] custom recipes.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Quality values are configurable through GMCM.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Designed to preserve long-run expected value while making individual cooking results more exciting.
[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][b]Required:[/b] SMAPI.
[b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM) for in-game configuration, and SpaceCore for compatibility with custom recipes using SpaceCore's ingredient system.
Neither GMCM nor SpaceCore is required for normal vanilla cooking.[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to [b]Amish-IT[/b], creator of [b]Chance-Based Cooking Quality[/b], whose open-source work helped inspire and inform the ingredient-tracking approach used during development.
Thanks to the [b]SMAPI, SpaceCore, and Stardew Valley modding communities[/b] for their tools, documentation, and resources.[/color][/*]
